risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantified information on backlog, customer concentration, restructuring charges, and program exposure, but several performance explanations defer to omitted tables and broad causal language. Key risks include pricing pressure, industry overcapacity, declining publication grades, substantial restructuring, and dependence on SAFRAN and aerospace programs. Overall tone is cautiously optimistic, emphasizing growth and cost initiatives while acknowledging persistent market pressures.
